rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something with no flaws, defects, or shortcomings.

example.english: This report is flawless and has almost no shortcomings.
example.traditional: 呢份報告寫得好完美，幾乎冇任何缺點。
example.jyutping: ne1 fan6 bou3 gou3 se2 dak1 hou2 jyun4 mei5 gei1 fu4 mou5 jam6 ho4 kyut3 dim2

rows.note: Use this colloquial phrase when praising a performance, product, or result as leaving nothing to criticize.

example.traditional: 你今晚個表演真係冇得彈。
example.jyutping: nei5 gam1 maan1 go3 biu2 jin2 zan1 hai6 mou5 dak1 taan4

rows.note: Use this mainly for a performance, argument, or approach that has no identifiable weakness.

example.traditional: 佢提出嘅論點無懈可擊。
example.jyutping: keoi5 tai4 ceot1 ge3 leon6 dim2 mou4 haai6 ho2 gik1
